newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures finish sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures finish sharply higher.

text.p: July 16 - U.S. debt futures finished sharply higher, with Sept T-bonds leading advances in an orderly, broad-based rally. Traders said Sept T-bonds were poised to test 115-03/32 in the near term. Mortgage-backed dealers seen extending duration, they said. One firm sold 8,000 red June Euros, bought red Sept.
